card.title: Neon Saturday
card.instruments: synth bass, simple four on the floor kick, one synth pluck
card.lyrics:
[verse]
Streetlights turning gold on the avenue
Everybody moving like they got something to prove
[chorus]
Saturday saturday don't let me down
We are the loudest thing in this town
Saturday saturday hold on tight
We are not going home tonight
card.note: Density experiment: same lyrics, key, tempo and seed as neon_saturday, with a thinner band. Testing whether arrangement density is what buries the vocal.
